name: Hemingway Woodshop
old_description: Hemingway Woodshop provides customized woodworking pieces for both your business and your home. Serving all of Minnesota and the Midwest.
about:
Hemingway Woodshop operates from Eagan, Minnesota, in the Twin Cities metro area. The shop is owned and operated by Benjamin (Ben), who works directly with clients on custom projects. No founding year is disclosed.

The company produces custom woodworking pieces including epoxy river tables, conference tables with logo engraving, dining tables, live-edge shelving, bookcases, bar tops, and countertops. They also take on unique requests such as archways for a cigar shop, garden beds for restaurants, and entertainment units. Work is quoted per project based on wood species, epoxy or finish, hardware, and labor.

Clients range from corporations needing statement conference tables to homeowners seeking one-of-a-kind dining tables and shelving. The shop serves both business and residential customers across Minnesota and the Midwest.

Hemingway Woodshop emphasizes that each piece is handcrafted locally and tailored to the client's vision and space, so customers do not have to compromise on fit or style.

name: Hemlock Semiconductor
old_description: Hemlock Semiconductor celebrates 65 years of innovation and impact
about:
Hemlock Semiconductor (HSC) operates a chemical processing facility in Hemlock, Michigan. Founded in 1961, the company has spent over six decades producing hyper-pure polysilicon. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed in the source material.

HSC is the only polysilicon manufacturer headquartered in the United States and one of five major producers worldwide. Its polysilicon serves as the foundational material for semiconductor wafers — the "brains" behind virtually all electronic devices — and for the solar power industry. The company emphasizes low embodied greenhouse gas emissions in its polysilicon, enabling ultra low-carbon solar panels that can reduce project embodied carbon by up to 50 percent.

HSC serves the semiconductor and solar industries. Its polysilicon is used in computer chips found in nearly all electronic devices globally, and by solar project developers and owners seeking lower-carbon panels.

The company states its vision is to become the preferred supplier of silicon-enabled technologies to the low-carbon, digital world. Its values — teamwork, responsibility, excellence, and customer focus — are described as the foundation of a culture built for lasting impact.

name: Hewtech Electronics LLC
old_description: We are an OEM supplier that specializes in custom development of precision fuel quantity level indication (FQI) modules for LNG fuel level monitoring using Capacitance Probes.
about:
Hewtech Electronics LLC operates from China Township, Michigan. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

The firm designs and manufactures electronic circuits, instruments, and control products, with a specialty in precision fuel quantity indication (FQI) modules for liquefied natural gas (LNG) level monitoring using capacitance probes. Its product line includes rotational speed monitoring alarms, tank switchers, LNG fueling station liquid/vapor detectors, and a series of cryogenic liquid nitrogen level alarms and controllers. Hewtech also provides end‑to‑end engineering support, electronic and PCB design (surface‑mount and through‑hole), prototype fabrication, design‑validation and process‑validation testing, and full‑scale production. The company handles certification to UL, FM, CSA, and CE standards and conducts EMC testing.

Hewtech serves original equipment manufacturers in industrial process control, aeronautics, medical, automotive, motorsports, biological freezing, cold storage, and alternative‑fuel vehicle (LNG) markets. Customers range from companies seeking private‑label products to those needing custom sensor and control solutions for cryogenic and high‑reliability applications.

The company emphasizes flexibility in adapting its technology without the high engineering costs typical of custom development, citing 40 years of experience in cryogenic liquid monitoring. It also offers its entire product portfolio and underlying intellectual property for acquisition, positioning itself as a source of ready‑to‑manufacture designs for organizations looking to expand their offerings quickly.

name: Hi-Lex Corporation
old_description: aims to make a drastic shift from mechanical control to electronic control.
about:
Hi-Lex Corporation operates from Battle Creek, Michigan, as the U.S. base of a Japanese cable and control-systems manufacturer that traces its expertise back more than 70 years. The company does not disclose a precise founding date or ownership structure in its public materials, but it presents itself as a long-established specialist in mechanical and electronic motion control.

The company's core technologies span ECU electronic control, systematization, modularization, control cables, and stranded wires. It produces system-level products for automotive applications — such as electronic parking brakes and lift-gate controllers — as well as for construction equipment, housing equipment, marine vessels, nursing care, and medical devices. Hi-Lex describes a global supply network but does not publish facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures.

Hi-Lex serves original equipment manufacturers and tier-one suppliers in the automotive, construction, housing, marine, nursing-care, and medical-equipment sectors. Concrete examples from its communications include an ECU that controls lift gates on SUVs and a 2023 agreement to distribute U.S. vascular-therapy products exclusively in Japan.

Hi-Lex states that its differentiation lies in a deliberate shift from mechanical cable systems to electronic control, turning its core cable technology into applied electronic and modular solutions. It also cites a dominant market share for automotive products in Japan and a 70-year experience base as reasons customers choose it.

name: Highland Packaging Solutions (A TOPPAN Company)
old_description: Highland Packaging Solutions has joined the TOPPAN Group. We'll still be serving your needs under the Highland brand with cost-effective, premium packaging for produce and eggs.
about:
Highland Packaging Solutions operates from Plant City, Florida, where it produces packaging for produce and eggs. The company became part of the TOPPAN Group, continuing to serve customers under the Highland brand.

Highland manufactures clamshell containers, egg cartons, and other produce packaging using PET material. Its in-house capabilities include flexographic printing, label application, thermoforming, extrusion, and 3D printing, supported by a full-service graphic design team and integrated inventory management. The company emphasizes large-volume production and quick turnaround.

The company serves growers and major retailers in the food packaging and agricultural sectors across North America, South America, and Europe. Highland works directly with produce growers, walking fields to understand market trends, and supplies packaging that meets the sustainability requirements of large retail chains.

Highland states that its focus on the human element drives its approach: helping customers and employees reach their full potential. It positions itself as a single resource for design, labeling, and inventory management to get products to market quickly.

name: Hill Metal Co
old_description: Hill Metal Co is a locally owned and operated company that has been in business since 1917. The current owners acquired the business in 1996.
about:
Founded in 1917, Hill Metal Co has been a fixture in Allentown, Pennsylvania for over a century. The business remains locally owned and operated; the current ownership group took over in 1996 and has maintained the shop's focus on custom metal fabrication and welding.

Today the company runs a fabrication shop that delivers custom sheet metal work and welding across a variety of metals, including aluminum, galvanized steel, stainless steel, carbon steel, and other alloys. While the facility size and employee count are not publicly specified, the shop handles projects for residential, commercial, and industrial clients.

The customer base spans homeowners needing custom railings or decorative pieces, commercial contractors requiring structural steel components, and industrial firms ordering equipment parts and machinery guards. The company does not publish a client list but describes its work as covering residential, commercial, and industrial metal fabrication and welding.

Hill Metal Co differentiates itself through its long local history, free estimates, and a stated commitment to high-quality work at reasonable prices. The firm highlights over 100 years of continuous operation in the Lehigh Valley as a testament to its reliability.

name: Hill Packaging
old_description: Maximize Your Efficiency, Reduce Production Downtime, Increase Profitability
about:
Hill Packaging traces its roots to 1946, when R.E. Hill Co. opened a modest Boston office brokering coffee. Now in its fourth generation of family ownership, the company operates from a facility in Derry, New Hampshire, serving manufacturers across New England.

The firm supplies packaging equipment and materials—including box erecting and sealing machines, flexible packaging systems, marking and coding printers (continuous inkjet, thermal inkjet, laser, and valve jet), and void-fill and cushioning products. It also maintains a large inventory of manufacturer parts and provides in-house and on-site repair services, emergency technician dispatch, and hazardous-waste disposal compliant with New Hampshire Department of Environmental Services requirements.

Hill Packaging’s customer base consists of New England manufacturers seeking to streamline packaging lines and protect products during transit. The company works with brands such as Foxjet, Leibinger, Pregis, Ranpak, Signode, Squid Ink, and Little David, integrating their equipment into end-of-line systems.

Leadership emphasizes that the company’s differentiator is its people: a team of packaging specialists with decades of experience who craft tailored solutions rather than simply selling products. The family-owned structure, they say, allows a level of care and responsiveness that larger corporations often cannot match.

name: Hitachi Energy Ltd
old_description: Hitachi Energy and Samsung C&T expand strategic collaboration
about:
Hitachi Energy Ltd operates from Jefferson City, Missouri, drawing on a heritage the company describes as spanning more than a century. The business traces its pioneering spirit to early innovations in power technology, though a specific founding year and founder names are not disclosed in public materials. Ownership structure is not specified.

The company designs and manufactures high-voltage direct current (HVDC) systems, transformer components, insulation materials, switchgear, and circuit breakers. It also delivers energy services and consulting, advanced services for switchgear and breakers, Grid-eMotion service offerings, and digitally enabled services through Hitachi Digital Services. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not published.

Customers include electric utilities, grid operators, and industrial firms building or modernizing power infrastructure. The company cites work across Europe and the United States, supporting projects that expand transmission capacity and integrate renewable generation.

Hitachi Energy states its purpose as "advancing a sustainable energy future for all," emphasizing affordable, reliable, and sustainable electricity. It frames its differentiation around a long record of pioneering technologies and a culture of innovation that pushes boundaries in power system evolution.
